# Fernly

> Fernly runs payroll, files your federal and state taxes, and handles benefits deductions for US companies with 5 to 50 employees. Unlimited pay runs, no setup fee.

Fernly was started in Portland, Oregon in 2021. It pays employees and 1099 contractors, calculates, pays and files federal, state and local payroll taxes (including Form 941, W-2s and 1099-NECs), registers companies with state agencies when they hire in a new state, and keeps health, dental, vision, 401(k) and FSA deductions in sync with payroll. Every account gets a named payroll specialist.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://payfernly.com/): Overview of Fernly payroll for small US teams
- [Pricing](https://payfernly.com/pricing): Essentials and Plus plans, priced per person
- [Payroll](https://payfernly.com/features/payroll): Running pay runs, direct deposit, bonuses and off-cycle runs
- [Benefits](https://payfernly.com/features/benefits): Health, dental, vision and 401(k) administration
- [Compliance](https://payfernly.com/features/compliance): State registrations, tax filings, new-hire reporting and paid leave
- [About](https://payfernly.com/about): Who started Fernly and why
- [Blog](https://payfernly.com/blog): Guides on payroll, taxes and hiring
- [Contact](https://payfernly.com/contact): Book a 20-minute demo
